environment.description: Application deployed on an EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2023, t3.medium) running as a systemd service under the 'webapp' user. TexLive full distribution installed (texlive-full). The service is exposed via an Application Load Balancer on port 443 with no WAF attached. The EC2 instance has an IAM instance profile with S3 read access and the instance metadata service (IMDSv1) enabled. The pdflatex binary runs with the same permissions as the Flask process. No AppArmor or SELinux confinement on the pdflatex process. The texmf.cnf has shell_escape=t (shell escape enabled by default from the distro package).
